abstract_sentences.text: AlphaFold3 introduces a diffusion-based architecture that elevates protein structure prediction to all-atom resolution with improved accuracy.
This state-of-the-art performance has established AlphaFold3 as a foundation model for diverse generation and design tasks.

evidence.anchor: foundation model for diverse generation and design tasks

abstract_sentences.text: However, its iterative design substantially increases inference time, limiting practical deployment in downstream settings such as virtual screening and protein design.

evidence.anchor: iterative design substantially increases inference time

abstract_sentences.text: We propose DCFold, a single-step generative model that attains AlphaFold3-level accuracy.

Our Dual Consistency training framework, which incorporates a novel Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) scheduler, enables DCFold to achieve a 15× acceleration in inference while maintaining predictive fidelity.
We validate its effectiveness across both structure prediction and binder design benchmarks.

evidence.anchor: structure prediction and binder design benchmarks

final_judgment.single_storyline: DCFold splits AF3’s diffusion and Pairformer loops, distills each with a distinct consistency target, and uses Fisher/KL temporal geometry to pair variable-length diffusion steps before testing one-pass structure quality, cost and binder utility.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: The body keeps the two-bottleneck motivation, Dual Consistency losses, TGM definitions/propositions and Algorithm 1, benchmark definitions, Tables 2–6 and Figures 1–5.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Proofs, Gaussian/EDM derivation, training hardware and steps, binder filters, runtime bins, sample counts, target metadata and qualitative cases move to p.14–18; B/C are needed to reproduce binder and cost claims.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 decomposes the bottlenecks, Table 1 fixes the staged loss contract, Figure 3 aligns NFE/cycles with lDDT, and Table 2 separates best-case from worst-case RMSD.
final_judgment.largest_gap: The 15× and AF3-level claims lack full sample counts, repeated training seeds and uncertainty; binder evidence is six-target in silico only; TGM stability is not a general convergence result and sCM is unavailable on long sequences.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For an iterative scientific model, assign one consistency target to each inference loop, match variable-size steps with an intrinsic/data-dimension-aware distance, and report average quality, tail failures, cost, mechanism diagnostics and downstream utility.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: The rule fits diffusion-plus-recycle models with reusable intermediate states. The Fisher/KL derivation assumes smooth classical Gaussian/EDM diffusion, and binder conclusions remain limited to six in-silico targets.

lexical_analysis.scope: Main p.1–10 proxy after excluding headers, page numbers, references, formula fragments and most caption/table lines.
lexical_analysis.interpretation: Model/component names and task metrics drive the lexical profile. Strong claims use achieves/attains/matches/surpasses; weaker phrases include approximately correct, no substantial deviation, slight and comparable.
